what: Cancel render move omits repo forwarding
scenario_or_breakage: For explicit --repo or non-default gh context, the moved driver render would call render-final-summary.sh without --repo, so the summary issue URL becomes N/A and the upsert may target the wrong repository or fail; the current inline calls preserve ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"}.
suggested_fix: Thread ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"} through both cancel-title-filter and cancel-reentry-guard render-final-summary.sh invocations in design-route.sh, and add the same pin to test-design-structure.sh.
